project.title: Warehouse Move & Metal Line Reconfiguration
project.objective: Plan and execute the relocation of warehouse inventory and reconfiguration of a metal drawing line to a new layout with minimal downtime and zero safety incidents.
deliverables: Detailed move and equipment relocation plan for warehouse and metal line
Updated warehouse layout and metal machine placement map
Standard operating procedure for loading, moving and unloading goods and machines
Safety and hazard checklist for moving heavy and dangerous goods
Post-move verification report on inventory accuracy and machine test runs
constraints: All moves must be completed during two consecutive weekends to avoid production loss
No damage to machines, inventory or facility infrastructure is acceptable
Compliance with internal safety rules for handling heavy and dangerous goods
Limited access to external lifting equipment; must schedule shared resources
Metal drawing line must be fully operational within 24 hours after relocation

risks.risk: Damage to machines or inventory during lifting, transport or unloading.
risks.mitigation: Use standardized packing, lifting plans and checklists; assign experienced movers to critical loads; perform pre-move equipment inspections.

risks.risk: Delays in move causing production downtime beyond planned window.
risks.mitigation: Create detailed schedule with time buffers; pre-stage items; confirm equipment availability; run a small pilot move before full execution.

risks.risk: Safety incidents while handling heavy or dangerous goods.
risks.mitigation: Brief team on hazards; enforce PPE and safe lifting procedures; use spotters; review safety checklist before each shift.

risks.risk: Incorrect machine setup after relocation leading to quality issues.
risks.mitigation: Have metal drawing machine operator perform test runs and parameter checks; document baseline settings; sign-off required before restart.

themes.why_relevant: Coordinating tasks, time windows and shared equipment is critical to finish the move on time.
Team handles heavy loads and dangerous goods; procedures must be clear and followed.
Correct packing and labeling avoids loss, damage and confusion after the move.

themes.theme: Metal drawing line setup and test runs
themes.why_relevant: The metal drawing machine operator must ensure the line runs correctly after relocation.
Clear instructions and quick updates reduce rework and idle time during the move.

backlog.task: Map current and target warehouse layout including metal drawing line position
definition_of_done: Current storage zones and machine positions documented on a simple map
Target layout with new locations for inventory and metal line approved by warehouse supervisor
Layout uploaded and linked in the channel

backlog.task: Create detailed move schedule and equipment booking plan
definition_of_done: Move broken into steps with estimated times and sequence
Required lifting and moving equipment listed and time slots reserved
Schedule shared with production and logistics stakeholders

backlog.task: Draft safety and hazard checklist for moving heavy and dangerous goods
definition_of_done: Checklist covers PPE, lifting techniques and dangerous goods handling
Reviewed with health and safety officer
Final version posted and acknowledged by all team members

backlog.task: Define packing and labeling standards for inventory and machine parts
definition_of_done: Types of packaging materials and labels defined for each category of goods
Label format for destination zone and content agreed
Short guide shared and used during packing

backlog.task: Prepare inventory list and pre-move stock count for affected areas
definition_of_done: All items in move scope listed with quantities and locations
Discrepancies flagged to warehouse supervisor
Baseline inventory sheet stored and linked

backlog.task: Plan disconnection, securing and loading of metal drawing machines
definition_of_done: Steps for shutting down and securing machines documented
Special handling requirements for each machine identified
Plan validated with maintenance technician

backlog.task: Execute packing, loading and transport for first move window
definition_of_done: Items for first window packed according to standards
Loads secured and transported without incident
Any issues logged in incident record

backlog.task: Reinstall and set up metal drawing line in new location
definition_of_done: Machines positioned according to new layout
Connections and controller settings checked
Test run completed with acceptable quality and cycle time

backlog.task: Post-move inventory verification and location update
definition_of_done: Random checks confirm items are in correct new locations
Inventory sheet updated with new positions
Any missing or damaged items reported

backlog.task: Document lessons learned and improvement ideas for future moves
definition_of_done: Team feedback collected on what worked and what did not
Top improvement actions listed and prioritized
Summary shared with warehouse and production stakeholders

artifacts.used_for: Plan time slots, tasks and shared use of forklifts, cranes and trucks during the move.

artifacts.title: Packing and Labeling Standards Guide
artifacts.used_for: Explain how to pack, label and stack goods and machine parts for safe transport.

artifacts.title: Safety and Hazard Checklist for Moving Operations
artifacts.used_for: Verify PPE, lifting practices and dangerous goods handling before and during moves.

artifacts.title: Pre- and Post-Move Inventory List
artifacts.used_for: Track quantities and locations of items before and after relocation to ensure accuracy.

artifacts.title: Metal Drawing Line Shutdown and Startup Procedure
artifacts.used_for: Guide the operator through safe shutdown, relocation checks and test runs.

artifacts.title: Move Issues and Incident Log
artifacts.used_for: Record any delays, near misses, damages or safety incidents during the move.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, roles and overall move schedule before work starts.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the warehouse and metal line relocation project.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the overall move schedule and weekend windows in A1.
Confirm who leads coordination on-site during each move window.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and agree on packing, labeling and inventory procedures.
threads_plan.trigger: Question about how to label mixed pallets and machine parts for the new layout.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final label format and color coding described in A2.
Agree on the cut-off time for completing pre-move inventory in A4.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Clarify safety rules and hazard controls for heavy and dangerous goods.
threads_plan.trigger: Mover raises concern about handling a batch of dangerous goods and tight aisles.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final version of the safety checklist A3 for this move.
Decide which loads require additional spotters or restricted access zones.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate metal drawing line shutdown, relocation and test runs.
threads_plan.trigger: Metal drawing machine operator shares the draft shutdown and startup steps.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the exact time window for shutting down the metal drawing line.
Approve the test run criteria for declaring the line operational after move.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review move results, inventory accuracy and lessons learned.
threads_plan.trigger: Post-move message requesting feedback and confirmation of completion.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm that inventory differences in A4 are acceptable or require follow-up.
Agree on top improvement actions to keep for the next relocation.

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in during move windows with yesterday done, today plan and blockers.
Pre-window safety reminder post summarizing key points from the safety checklist.
End-of-window recap summarizing completed tasks, incidents and schedule impact.
Post-project retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and improvement ideas.
